    def terminal_exit(self, raw=False):
        outfile = Path(self.tmp.name)/('raw' if raw else 'joined')
        args = [str(self.exe), '--no-isolation', '-d', 'echo one\n#comment\n| cat\n',
                '-o', str(outfile)]
        if raw:
            args.append('-r')
        pid, fd = pty.fork()
        if pid == 0:
            os.environ['HOME'] = self.tmp.name
            os.environ['TERM'] = 'xterm-256color'
            os.environ.pop('XDG_CONFIG_HOME', None)
            os.execv(str(self.exe), args)
        fcntl.ioctl(fd, termios.TIOCSWINSZ, struct.pack('HHHH', 24, 80, 0, 0))
        data = b''
        sent = False
        deadline = time.monotonic()+4
        try:
            while time.monotonic() < deadline:
                readable, _, _ = select.select([fd], [], [], .04)
                if readable:
                    try:
                        chunk = os.read(fd, 65536)
                    except OSError as exc:
                        if exc.errno == errno.EIO:
                            break
                        raise
                    if not chunk:
                        break
                    data += chunk
                if not sent and b'Command' in data:
                    os.write(fd, b'\x1b')
                    sent = True
            done, status = os.waitpid(pid, os.WNOHANG)
            if not done:
                os.kill(pid, signal.SIGKILL)
                os.waitpid(pid, 0)
                self.fail('terminal application did not exit')
            self.assertEqual(status, 0)
            self.assertIn(b'\x1b[?1049l', data)
        finally:
            os.close(fd)
        expected = 'echo one\n#comment\n| cat' if raw else 'echo one #comment | cat'
        self.assertEqual(outfile.read_text(), expected)
